title: MASEMiner
tagline: Extract correlation matrices, single correlations, and study metadata for Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling
description: Domain-agnostic MASEMiner workflow.  Extracts variable-level correlation matrices and single correlations reported in body text, plus coded study metadata, suitable for downstream meta-analytic structural equation modeling.  Use the in-app builder to add factor loadings + correlations (psychometric MASEM) or to define variables / constructs of interest.  A TAS-20 example is one click away.
task_description: Extract scale-level / construct-level correlations from primary studies for MASEM.  Variables of interest are theoretical constructs (with synonyms) — count any reported correlation between two listed constructs, regardless of which scale was used to measure them.
context: General MASEM workflow. Reports the variable × variable correlation matrix(es) and single inline correlations from prose. The user is expected to define their theoretical constructs (with definitions and synonyms) before running.
